timeNow = system.date.now()
	hourNow = system.date.getHour24(system.date.addHours(timeNow, 1))
	endDate = system.date.setTime(timeNow, hourNow, 0, 0)

	data = system.kanoa.event.getOEEDataByInterval(value, system.date.addHours(endDate,-12), endDate, 'Hour')
	data = system.dataset.filterColumns(data, ['hourTimestamp', 'oee', 'availability', 'performance', 'quality'])	
	
	if data.rowCount > 12: data = system.dataset.deleteRows(data, [i for i in range(data.rowCount - 12)])
	return data

if value['showAssetPath'] is False: return ''
	if value['assetPath'] is None: return ''
	
	assetPath = value['assetPath'].split("\\")[-1]
	return system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(assetPath, {})

if value['modeSourceName'] == 'Schedule': return 'Mode set by schedule'
	name = value.userName if value.userName is not None and value.userName != 'tagChange' else value.modeSourceName
	return 'Mode set by %s'%name or ''

if value == 'Schedule': icon = 'material/calendar_today'
	elif value == 'PLC': icon = 'kanoa/cell'
	elif value in ('Operator', 'Operator Run'): icon = 'material/engineering'
	else: icon = ''
	
	return icon

if value is None: return ''
	tagPath = self.view.custom.asset.assetInfo.tagPath 
	
	#measure from the latest state event OR the latest mode event, whichever is sooner	
	currentStateStartTime = system.tag.read(tagPath + '/Line/OEE/stateName').timestamp if tagPath else None
	currentModeStartTime = system.date.fromMillis(value['startDate'])

	times = []
	if currentStateStartTime: times.append(currentStateStartTime)
	if currentModeStartTime: times.append(currentModeStartTime)
	measureFrom = max(times)
	secs = system.date.secondsBetween(measureFrom, system.date.now()) if measureFrom else 0	
	return system.kanoa.utilities.secondsToText(secs, {'showSecs': False, 'roundUp': True})
